title: Cosmic Gathering by the River
description: A surreal nighttime scene shows a large crowd of people seated in an outdoor amphitheater facing a glowing river that flows toward a massive swirling cosmic portal in the sky. The portal features concentric rings of orange, purple, and white surrounding a brilliant central star, framed by dramatic purple and golden nebulae with hanging crystalline droplets.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape at night, a vast outdoor amphitheater filled with an audience seated facing a glowing river that winds toward the horizon. In the sky floats a gigantic swirling cosmic portal with concentric rings of orange, purple and white around a brilliant central star. Dramatic purple and golden nebulae frame the scene with hanging crystalline droplets falling from the clouds, trees with hanging lanterns on both sides, highly detailed, cinematic lighting.
